steps.text:
I've built the scripture card and handed in the record; it passes validation with no errors or warnings. It is not saved to your NoaCG library: that happens on your side from the handed-in record.

**How it looks:** a soft cream panel with rounded corners sits across the lower part of the frame, inside the safe area. A thin burgundy line runs under the heading row, which has the heading "Y DARLLENIAD · THE READING" on the left and the reference ("Eseia 40:31 · Isaiah 40:31") on the right in bold dark type. Below that, the two readings sit side by side so they can be read at once: Welsh on the left in a slightly bolder dark ink, English on the right in a warm dark brown, with a fine line between them. Both use a serif typeface (Lora) at about 42px with generous line spacing, which is large for older viewers. Lora includes the Welsh letters ŵ and ŷ, and it ships with the graphic under its open font licence.

**Handling longer Welsh text:**
- The Welsh column is about 18% wider than the English one.
- The panel grows upward as the text gets longer. If a reading would push the panel above the middle of the frame, the text steps down in size, to no smaller than about 30px.
